phenomenon: Specific peer boundary with later membership
boundary_belonging_explanation: Boundaries are interaction-specific and need not erase membership
institution_identity_explanation: Institutional participation can open membership without removing cultural difference
brokerage_agency_explanation: Selective identity adjustment can coexist with retained difference
process_context_explanation: Timing separates initial incidents from later appraisal
agreement: Boundary and belonging are non-identical and can coexist
rival_explanations: Recall frame; response compression; ordinary newcomer dynamics
overinterpretation_risk: Turning coexistence into a universal trajectory

phenomenon: Group task as institutional and relational interface
boundary_belonging_explanation: Invitation and grouping practices regulate peer access
institution_identity_explanation: The task can expose participation requirements; hidden rules require separate evidence
brokerage_agency_explanation: Taking a role can show constrained agency
process_context_explanation: Teacher grouping and class composition shape opportunity
agreement: The same scene can carry academic and relational functions
rival_explanations: Task design or teacher allocation may explain more than culture
overinterpretation_risk: Writing a one-case event chain as causal

phenomenon: Rule difficulty with later rule understanding
boundary_belonging_explanation: Belonging does not mechanically remove institutional friction
brokerage_agency_explanation: Ability judgments can differ from task difficulty
process_context_explanation: Different retrospective dimensions coexist; change is unobserved
agreement: Rule understanding and task ease are distinct

phenomenon: Self-reported prior strengths and learner identity
institution_identity_explanation: Multiple good-student criteria coexist; the translation process is unobserved
process_context_explanation: Subject and assessment are possible rivals
agreement: Self-reported usability does not establish a translation mechanism

phenomenon: Support that helps or remains limited
boundary_belonging_explanation: Trust and invitation are case-level interpretations
institution_identity_explanation: Rule explanation is one support function
brokerage_agency_explanation: Timing, fit and visibility are framework-dependent
process_context_explanation: Family schedule, cost and school provision are rivals
agreement: Three support states are distinct; configuration mechanisms are exploratory

phenomenon: Same-background safety circle with possible trade-off
boundary_belonging_explanation: A protective tie can soften one boundary while sustaining another
process_context_explanation: Stage and available classmates are rivals
agreement: A trade-off is plausible but explicitly reported in one case
overinterpretation_risk: Generalising a single explicit trade-off account

brokerage_agency_explanation: Platform choice is not brokerage or identity
digital_relationship_explanation: Self-reported coexistence and function allocation fit media repertoire
process_context_explanation: Prior ties and school requirements are rivals
agreement: Platforms coexist; actual mechanism is unobserved
rival_explanations: Popularity and institutional requirement rather than identity

phenomenon: High brokerage self-report without uniformly high belonging
boundary_belonging_explanation: Boundary translation may not remove exclusion
brokerage_agency_explanation: Network position, action and identity must be separated
overinterpretation_risk: Converting two Likert items into observed brokerage

phenomenon: Leaving a pathway while retaining selected relations or practices
boundary_belonging_explanation: Exit does not prove failed belonging
institution_identity_explanation: A pathway can change while practices are retained
brokerage_agency_explanation: Selective retention is a possible identity interpretation
process_context_explanation: Academic pressure and pathway fit provide institutional rivals
agreement: Exit and selective retention coexist in limited cases
rival_explanations: Family plans; assessment stakes; mobility constraints
overinterpretation_risk: Reading retrospective retention as verified trajectory

phenomenon: Silence about platform mechanisms in interviews
boundary_belonging_explanation: Absence cannot establish no digital boundary
institution_identity_explanation: Interview coverage may prioritise other episodes
brokerage_agency_explanation: No mention cannot establish no agency
digital_relationship_explanation: Survey functions lack event-rich interview evidence
agreement: Non-mention is ambiguous rather than negative evidence
rival_explanations: Topic salience; interview coverage; unwillingness or forgetting
overinterpretation_risk: Using silence as proof of absence
